title: The Rememberer

texts.details:
I've been listenin' to the mountaineers since ye went. The Frostmane patriarch, Great Father Arctikus, keeps to the cave at Frostmane Hold, out west past Iceflow Lake. But it's an elder at the foot o' the Hold, Jin'zakk, who does the talkin'. The mountaineers call him the Rememberer.

He tells the young trolls what Senir told you: that all this was theirs. Then the snowstriders carry his word from camp to camp, an' the raids begin.

Senir wants him dead, an' five o' the striders with him. I'll no' pretend it's a clean thing I'm askin', $N. The troll's sayin' nothin' that isn't so.
texts.objectives: Kill Jin'zakk the Rememberer below Frostmane Hold and 5 Frostmane Snowstriders, then return to Yori Crackhelm in Kharanos.
texts.progress: He'll be at the foot o' the Hold, south-west o' Brewnall Village. The striders run the snow around Iceflow Lake.
texts.completion:
Then it's done, an' the roads will be quieter for a season.

It won't last. A tale doesn't die with the one who tells it. Some young troll heard every word, an' he'll be sayin' it himself by spring.

But I'll tell ye what I'm goin' to do, $N. When I've bairns o' my own an' they ask why the trolls hate us, I'm goin' to tell them. Here. Ye earned it.

idea: Chain 2 of 2: the Frostmane are trying to take Dun Morogh back while Ironforge is busy elsewhere; Great Father Arctikus is their patriarch.
